name: play_runtime_objects
description: PM-3c: Studio starts the engine in edit, where the spawner's behavior sleeps: nothing is spawned and the Outliner has no runtime row. Play runs it, and it spawns one object, Shot, on its first step. The Outliner lists it after the scene's own objects as "Shot (runtime)"; selected, the Inspector shows its runtime Transform read-only and the Outliner's Delete and Duplicate are off. Stop empties the list and the row goes; Play again spawns it again and the row comes back.
